expectedRealization.rationale: Emergency PPE shortages can move earnings quickly, but durability and price absorption must be resolved before any equity selection.

changeHypothesis.summary: PPE and meltblown-material shortages were unquestionably real, yet listed expressions ranged from immaterial exposure to extreme prior rerating. The bottleneck itself is not enough to create a sound entry.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Shortage can persist for weeks, but emergency capacity additions and eventual epidemic normalization can compress scarcity profits rapidly.
disconfirmingEvidence: 道恩 had already risen more than 300% from early February.
Company disclosures said meltblown-material revenue was not a high share of total revenue.
Shanghai Petrochemical capacity was direct but likely small relative to the parent business.

causalChain.mechanism: Mask output requires meltblown material and special polypropylene feedstock.
Only material revenue share and sustainable pricing can create meaningful earnings.
causalChain.failureMode: revenue share is too small or product pricing is constrained

aShareCandidates.name: 道恩股份
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Direct meltblown polypropylene exposure, but earnings materiality and valuation were already problematic.

earningsSensitivity.base: Direct product demand is real but revenue share historically modest.

aShareCandidates.name: 上海石化
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Direct emergency meltblown-material capacity but contribution to a large integrated petrochemical company is unproven.

earningsSensitivity.base: Capacity increased, but earnings materiality is unknown.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Contribution remains immaterial to group earnings.

selectionComparison.rationale: Do not select: one expression is extremely absorbed and the other lacks demonstrated earnings materiality.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: PPE basket +137.5pp 60d excess; 道恩 alone +265pp excess and around 129x PE by early March.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Real shortage is not enough unless listed-company earnings materiality and duration are both measurable.
expectations.measurableGap: No candidate combines under-reflected price, material earnings exposure and durable scarcity.

bearCase: Scarcity headlines peak just as new capacity arrives; concept equities de-rate before earnings can justify prices.

invalidationConditions.threshold: material sustainable earnings contribution plus normalized valuation

nextResearchActions: No selection; preserve as a canonical 'real bottleneck does not equal buyable equity' case.
